title: Restore identifiers
summary: Put originals back in place of [KIND_N] placeholders; unknown tokens stay.

sections.use: The last step of the de-identification workflow: replace each [KIND_N] placeholder in a model's reply with its original, using the map that check_identifier_map passed.
sections.exclusions: Not a check of the map; place check_identifier_map before the Release Gate for that.
sections.effects: Runs locally with no network or model. Every port is Local only because the output contains originals.
sections.limitations: Replaces exact placeholder tokens only: a placeholder the remote model reworded or split is not restored.
sections.missing_data: An unknown token, such as a [DRAFT] that was in the source, is left in place and listed in the step details, as are pairs that were not used.
sections.failures: A malformed map fails the step with a located issue; nothing is sent anywhere.

inputs.text: The text with placeholders, usually a remote model's reply.
inputs.pairs: The identifier map, from check_identifier_map's out pairs.
